annotations.title: Solana wallets that were early on winners

description: Solana wallets recorded among a token's first buyers on tokens whose peak later reached 5x the scan cap, with the base rate (meta.base_5x, about one in twenty) beside every rate. Sprayers, at-or-below-base and silent wallets are removed with the reason. Wallet identity showed no out-of-sample edge on Solana: this answers who was early, not who to copy.
name: sol_early_wallets
